title: Canonical catalog, variants, import mapping/preview and product-content refs
scope_items: Canonical Catalog & Variant Management: Implemented Product and ProductSku domain model, validation rules (title required, non-empty, product type in physical/digital/service, base price non-negative exact decimal with 3-character ISO currency, SKU code unique per product), status lifecycle (draft, active, archived), and PostgreSQL RLS tenant isolation.

Import Preview & Mapping Engine: Implemented complete mapping engine with header alias resolution dictionary, field validation, formula injection neutralization (escaping '=', '+', '-', '@' characters), account-scoped external ID deduplication, in-file duplicate suppression, and deterministic sorted-key preview tokens.

Acceptance Target 1: Deduplication strictly scoped by workspace_id + connected_account_id + platform + external_id. Two different shops with the identical external source ID remain completely independent products without cross-account collision.

Acceptance Target 2: Repeated rows within an import file or re-importing unchanged data are recognized via external ID and data hashing and marked as unchanged no-ops (unchanged), creating no redundant database records or mutations.

Acceptance Target 3: Malformed or unmapped required columns flag requires_mapping_correction = true with detailed mapping_errors, generating no preview token and preventing commit until mappings are corrected.
Product-Content References: Bidirectional linking between products and creative content assets (content_id, media_url, content_type), tracking performance metrics and linked assets.

Multi-Target Protobuf Contracts: Consolidated 19 canonical RPCs from rpc_permission_bindings.csv into protos/creativanta/commerce/v1/product.proto. Generated and verified across all four targets (Go, Connect-Go, TypeScript, Dart) with zero codegen drift.
Outbox Domain Events: Emits product.created and product.catalog_status_changed into transactional outbox upon catalog mutations.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget1_TwoShopsWithSameSourceIDRemainSeparate verifies that two distinct connected accounts importing identical source ID SH-SKU-999 create two distinct product records.
Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget2_RepeatedRowsNoOp verifies that repeated rows in the same CSV or repeated imports produce no-op unchanged results.
Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget3_InvalidMappingsNeedCorrection verifies that missing required column mappings flag correction required and refuse commit until corrected.
Formula Injection Neutralization Verified: TestFormulaInjectionNeutralization verifies cells beginning with '=', '+', '-', '@' are safely prefixed with a single quote.
Preview Token Integrity Verified: TestPreviewTokenMismatchRejection verifies tamper prevention via SHA-256 fingerprint validation.
ConnectRPC Handler Verified: TestConnectHandler_CreateAndGet verifies Connect-Go unary handlers for ProductService.
Stock & Content Ref Lifecycle Verified: TestProductLifecycle_CRUD, TestStockUpdateAndThresholds, and TestProductContentLinking verify full catalog and variant operations.
Zero Future Phase Exposure Verified: TestNoFuturePhaseRPCExposed in internal/rbac confirms module M13 is authorized for Phase P1 and all future phase RPCs (P2-P8) fail closed.

cd apps/api && go mod verify && go vet ./...

external_gates: External Marketplace APIs (TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada): Live merchant API tokens unconfigured in local test environment; import engine uses standardized CSV/JSON parsing and simulated payloads.
Clerk Auth Provider: Live Clerk session validation unconfigured; verified using local test context and tenant claims.
PostgreSQL 17 Database: In-memory store utilized for unit tests; PostgreSQL store implements tenant RLS context and query contracts ready for live service container in CI.
remaining_scope: P1-02: Inventory sync, stock ledger, multi-warehouse allocations.
P1-03: Order ingestion, state machine, multi-shop fulfillment.
decisions: Consolidated ProductService RPC block in protos/creativanta/commerce/v1/product.proto following protobuf_contracts.md Rule 2.
Exact decimal arithmetic using standard math/big.Rat (and tenantdb.ExactDecimal) avoiding IEEE-754 float precision loss per DB-H-001.
Account-scoped deduplication key (workspace_id + connected_account_id + platform + external_id) ensures strict separation across merchant accounts per data_migration_strategy.md §3.
Formula injection neutralization escapes leading '=', '+', '-', '@' characters with a single quote prefix.
notes: P1-01 Canonical catalog, variants, import preview and content refs implemented and verified locally. All three acceptance targets verified with automated tests. Full multi-target codegen, Go race test suite, Node quality gate, and Flutter mobile test suite pass cleanly.
